dedupe_keys.name: 福岡市消防情報メール fire police and emergency services

description: 福岡市消防情報メール [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 福岡市. 福岡市消防局が配信する福岡市内の火災、事故、救急等の発生をお知らせするメルマガ「ふくしょうめーる」を解析し、データ化しています。. Coverage: 福岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 福岡市. Its tags are 防災. It offers 11 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
